title: Chichemo Chanzwikwa Pamusoro Peruzha
intro: Unonzwa inzwi richikwira kubva munharaunda umo kudzvinyirirwa kwave tsika. Hapana kuratidzwa kwesimba kunopindura kunyunyuta; panzvimbo pezvo, chikumbiro chakananga chinosvika kuna Allah, uye mhinduro yacho inobaya pamoyo pekunamata pachako. Ndiani akanyunyuta kudaro, mubvunzo upi wakatevera, uye chokwadi chipi chakasimbiswa?
clues: Ndakataura chichemo ichocho zvakananga kuna Allah munyunyuto yangu.
Allah akanzwa kunyunyuta uye akapindura nepfungwa pamusoro pezvandaitenda.
Mhinduro yacho yakabvunza kuti ndaizotadza sei kutenda muna Allah, uyo ari Mumwe chete uye Mukurusa.
Ndakabva ndabvunza kuti sei Allah achifanira kupa vanhu vasingatendi nyasha.
Ndini Uzair, ndakatumidzwa muSurah Az-Zukhruf kuti ndini ndakanzwa kunyunyuta kwangu naAllah.
